answer: A farm has to recruit observers outside its own infrastructure, as a result paying parties whose interest is to report honestly. Cosignatures are collected in knoll, verified in copper, and nebula names every witness. Each submission needs cosignature from 3 independent nodes that observed it arrive, and a node cannot cosign more than 47 submissions per epoch. Every extra alias adds 3 hours of verification and 5 percent more locked value. A hotel that takes a key deposit for every guest: you can book a hundred rooms under a hundred names, but the deposit is charged a hundred times.
